| Current item | Recommendation |

| `composition/shortcuts.config.ts` | Keep. It assembles product-specific shortcut defaults. |
| `chrome/WiredTopNav.svelte`, `WiredLeftNav.svelte` | Keep. These connect the independent shell to account, search, capture, and other product surfaces. |
| `branding/SubAtomLogo.svelte` | Keep as a product-brand adapter. It reads product identity; moving it wholesale into portable UI would be wrong. |
| `paint/ComponentResolver.svelte` | Keep. Resolving configured actions into concrete components is composition. |
| `paint/AppLoadingView.svelte` | Keep. It assembles the product-aware startup presentation. |
| `layers/` application entry components | Keep their orchestration responsibilities, but extract the implementations described below. |
| `settingsActionMap.ts` | Move internally to `application/composition/settings-actions.ts`. It assembles concrete settings components, rather than providing plain configuration. |
| `package.json`, `README.md` | Keep, but tighten the charter after agreeing on ownership. |

| `record/BulkEditBar.svelte` | `surfaces/library/bulk-edit/` | It implements cross-resource editing workflows, not shell arrangement. `WiredTopNav` should continue injecting it into the shell. |
| `record/resource-link.utils.ts` | `shell/navigation/resource-link.utils.ts` | Resource URL construction belongs with navigation policy. |
